newsitem.title: UK: Senior down in heavy trade as sale delayed.
newsitem.headline: Senior down in heavy trade as sale delayed.

text.p: Shares in Senior Engineering Plc dropped in heavy trading on Friday after the company said the planned sale of its thermal engineering division had been delayed and expected proceeds had been cut by one million stg.
The stock was down 6p at 115-1/2 in trade of 16.5 million shares, making it the second most active stock in the UK market.

Earlier Senior said expected profits on the sale had been revised downwards as a result of higher-than-expected costs in the industrial boilers unit and because less repair work had been won than had been expected in the United States.
It said it still expected the sale to be completed on or before December 20.
